description: This file defines the Complex class for handling complex number calculations within the PhpSpreadsheet library, including methods for creating complex numbers and extracting their real and imaginary parts.

classes.name: Complex
classes.description: A class providing static methods for complex number operations such as creation, extracting imaginary and real parts, used in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: COMPLEX
methods.description: Converts real and imaginary coefficients into a complex number string, supporting array inputs.

methods.name: IMAGINARY
methods.description: Returns the imaginary part of a complex number, supporting array inputs.

methods.name: IMREAL
methods.description: Returns the real part of a complex number, supporting array inputs.
